messages:
Anne: Quick sync — planning a retrospective for the search-regen regression from last Wed. Thinking a 30m live sync + async action table. Who needs to be in the live 30m? My proposal: SRE (oncall), runtime owner, release lead, and the PM. Proposed slots: Wed 10:00am PT or Thu 4:00pm PT. Thoughts? :calendar:

Juan: Wed 10am PT works for me. I'll take the incident timeline + chronology. Is 30m likely enough to cover RCA + action assignment? :thinking_face:

Priya: Thu 4pm also okay for me but prefer shorter. Agree agenda should be strict: context, timeline, findings, decisions, owners. Please add a pre-read (logs + repro).

Matt: I can attend Wed. Add 'verify rollback playbook' as a potential action. Also would like the rollout owner present — I'll attend for that.

InfraBot: Calendar invite created (tentative): https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123 — Wed 2025-02-05 17:00UTC / 10:00am PT.

Anne: Thanks — locking Wed 10am PT then. Draft agenda (please edit inline):

```
30m retro — search-regen regression
- 0-5m: Context & impact (PM)
- 5-15m: Incident timeline (Juan)
- 15-25m: Root cause summary & mitigation options (eng leads)
- 25-30m: Actions, owners, due dates, and verification plan
```

Also added a Google doc for pre-reads and action table: https://docs.redwood.com/d/search-regen-retro (please drop logs, repro steps, and any small diffs).

Priya: :thumbsup: I added the minimal repro steps + the key logs to the doc. Suggest owners: Juan -> timeline writeup, Matt -> rollback runbook update, Priya -> alert thresholds tuning. I'll create the actions table rows now.

Sergei: Can we add a short item about on-call handoff and noisy alerts? I was paged and have a couple of notes about alert suppression windows.

Anne: Yes — please add those in the doc under 'operational notes'. Quick async rule: if you can't make the live 30m, add comments in the doc and assign an owner to the action. We'll collate and confirm owners during the meeting.

Juan: I'll populate the timeline and tag owners with this format: `owner: <name> | due: <YYYY-MM-DD> | verification: <how>`. Saves time in the meeting.

Matt: If it looks like we'll need deeper dive, we can extend to 45m, but let's try to keep it to 30. I'll sketch the rollback verification steps in the doc before the meeting.

Priya: RSVP'd 'maybe' to the Thu backup slot in case anyone in APAC can't make Wed. Also will add my timezone next to my name in the doc (UTC+5:30).

Anne: One last ask: when you RSVP in the calendar, please add your timezone (helps with APAC folks). If anyone wants to run a 1:1 pre-brief, ping me and we can sync for 10m. :slightly_smiling_face:

Juan: Sounds good — will be there and prep timeline.

Sergei: Added on-call notes and suggested alert changes to the doc.

Anne: Great — thanks all. I'll send the finalized invite and paste the action table template in the doc this afternoon. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
